content.thinking: I confirmed CLOSE_DT is a true NULL, REF_JRNL_NO is NULL on every row (no reversal links), and SRC_REF holds invoice/PAY-id values for AP journals but user names for GL journals, contrary to the dictionary. Next I'll dig deeper into payments, GL journal types, signs, and consistency checks.

input.sql: SELECT 'pay_hdr' k, h."MEMO" a, count(*)::text b, min(h."JRNL_NO")::text c FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'gl_memo', "MEMO", count(*)::text, min("JRNL_NO")::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='GL' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_memo_pattern', CASE WHEN "MEMO" LIKE 'Invoice %' THEN 'Invoice ...' ELSE "MEMO" END, count(*)::text, min("JRNL_NO")::text FROM "GLJRNH" WHERE "SRC_CD"='AP' AND "SRC_REF" NOT LIKE 'PAY-%' GROUP BY 2 UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_srcref_match_invno', 'match', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."SRC_REF"=i."INV_NO" UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_jrnl_dups', 'dups', count(*)::text, '' FROM (SELECT "JRNL_NO" FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_amt_vs_lines', 'mismatch', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE i."INV_AMT" <> (SELECT sum("CR_AMT") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" AND l."ACCT_CD"='2000    ') UNION ALL SELECT 'paid_vs_pay', 'paid_no_payment', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='P' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'open_with_payment', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i WHERE "STAT_CD"='O' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "APPAYM" p WHERE p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") UNION ALL SELECT 'multi_pay', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM (SELECT "INV_ID" FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_amt_ne_inv', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_amts', 'inv/pay', (SELECT count(*) FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<=0)::text, (SELECT count(*) FROM "APPAYM" WHERE "PAY_AMT"<=0)::text UNION ALL SELECT 'pay_before_inv', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" p JOIN "APINVH" i USING("INV_ID") WHERE p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'inv_dt_ne_post_dt', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM "APINVH" i JOIN "GLJRNH" h ON h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" WHERE h."POST_DT"<>i."INV_DT" UNION ALL SELECT 'dup_inv_no_vendor', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM (SELECT 1 FROM "APINVH" GROUP BY "VEND_CD","INV_NO" HAVING count(*)>1) x UNION ALL SELECT 'jrnl_range', min("JRNL_NO")::text, max("JRNL_NO")::text, count(distinct "JRNL_NO")::text FROM "GLJRNH" UNION ALL SELECT 'date_range_inv', min("INV_DT")::text, max("INV_DT")::text, '' FROM "APINVH" UNION ALL SELECT 'date_range_pay', min("PAY_DT")::text, max("PAY_DT")::text, '' FROM "APPAYM" UNION ALL SELECT 'inactive_acct_use', 'lines', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNL" WHERE "ACCT_CD"='5900    ' UNION ALL SELECT 'post_in_closed_after_close', 'n', count(*)::text, '' FROM "GLJRNH" h JOIN "GLPERD" p USING("PRD_ID") WHERE p."STAT_CD"='C' AND h."POST_DT">p."CLOSE_DT"

SELECT h."JRNL_NO", h."PRD_ID", h."POST_DT", h."SRC_REF", h."MEMO", (SELECT string_agg(l."ACCT_CD"||':'||l."DR_AMT"||'/'||l."CR_AMT", ' | ' ORDER BY l."LN_SEQ") FROM "GLJRNL" l WHERE l."JRNL_NO"=h."JRNL_NO") lines FROM "GLJRNH" h WHERE h."SRC_REF" LIKE 'PAY-%' ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3

SELECT l."ACCT_CD", c."ACCT_TYP", h."SRC_CD", count(*) n, sum("DR_AMT") dr, sum("CR_AMT") cr FROM "GLJRNL" l JOIN "GLCOA" c USING("ACCT_CD") JOIN "GLJRNH" h USING("JRNL_NO") GROUP BY 1,2,3 ORDER BY 1,3
